UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the authenticated player's profile and lifetime statistics.

userId.description: Unique Google user ID of the player.

highScore.description: Highest score achieved by the player.

favoriteSkin.description: Selected neon skin ID or name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord
MatchRecord.description: Represents an individual game run and its final results.

recordId.description: Unique ID of the match record.

userId.description: Google user ID of the player who played this match.

score.description: Final score earned in the match.

maxLength.description: Peak serpent length reached in the match.

skinName.description: Name of the serpent skin used.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Global leaderboard entry allowing players to showcase their top scores.

scoreId.description: Unique ID of the leaderboard score entry (typically userId).

userId.description: User ID of the record holder.

maxLength.description: Maximum length attained in top match.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when score was logged.

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile documents storing lifetime stats and favorite skin.

/users/{userId}/records/{recordId}.description: Individual match history runs for the player.

/leaderboard/{scoreId}.description: Global high scores leaderboard visible to all authenticated players.
